item.kultivator.shan_hai_scroll.tooltip: Calls %s in the Immortal Realm. Used up when the beast arrives.
item.kultivator.shan_hai_scroll.rule: Same refusals as the ascension; ignores the natural cooldown; repeat rewards still count toward Kelelahan Purba (3 per day).
item.kultivator.shan_hai_scroll.inspired: Inspired by the Shan Hai Jing (Classic of Mountains and Seas), the book that records Zhulong; the scroll itself is game design.
item.kultivator.kun_scale.tooltip: A scale of the great fish of the northern darkness, cold as the deep sea.
item.kultivator.kun_scale.source: Source: Zhuangzi ch. 1 "Free and Easy Wandering" (the fish Kun of the northern darkness).
item.kultivator.peng_feather.tooltip: A feather of the Peng, whose wings are like clouds across the sky.
item.kultivator.peng_feather.source: Source: Zhuangzi ch. 1 (Kun changes into the bird Peng; its wings are like clouds hanging from the sky).
item.kultivator.zhulong_scale.tooltip: A scarlet scale of the Candle Dragon, still warm as a candle flame.
item.kultivator.zhulong_scale.source: Source: Shan Hai Jing section 8 (Zhuyin of Bell Mountain: scarlet, a human face, a serpent body a thousand li long) and section 17 (Zhulong).
item.kultivator.taotie_fang.tooltip: A bronze-dark fang of the head without a body.
item.kultivator.taotie_fang.source: Source: Zuo Zhuan (one of the four evil creatures, a by-word for gluttony); Lushi Chunqiu 16/3a (on Zhou ding the taotie has a head but no body).
item.kultivator.zhulong_candle_eye.toolt: In the off hand: Night Vision, and Darkness falls away from you.
item.kultivator.zhulong_candle_eye.sourc: Source: Shan Hai Jing section 8 (when Zhuyin opens its eyes it is day; when it closes them it is night).
item.kultivator.heaven_seal_shard.toolti: Three of them soften every strike of one star calamity run (Segel Penangkal, x0.85).
item.kultivator.heaven_seal_shard.inspir: Inspired by I Shall Seal the Heavens Book 4 ch. 385-386 (the Heavens' lightning that hunts Meng Hao); the seal is game design.

kultivator.screen.help.binatang_purba: In the Immortal Realm Kun-Peng, Zhulong and Taotie can stir (a natural Gejolak about every 5 minutes, or a Mountains and Seas Scroll). Each fight has three phases; damage per second is capped, so watch for the Celah (opening) when the cap is four times higher. First kills give materials, Origin Stones and 40%% of a bar; repeats are limited to 3 per day. Holding six distinct Kunpeng bone pieces when Kun-Peng falls teaches the Kunpeng art.
kultivator.screen.help.bencana_bintang: Seven calamities gate your stars (the first at star 6, 7 or 8 by your breakthrough quality, then every 9 stars). Condensing stops before a gated star; begin the calamity from the Calamity tablet or /kultivasi bencana mulai. Survive 6 + k heavenly strikes and the envoy waves: the star condenses, and each finished Trial raises the T factor by x1.1. Failing leaves Luka Bencana and returns half the cost. Calamities behind an old save's stars are skipped and can be taken later for T.
kultivator.screen.help.murka_langit: Once you have faced a calamity, the Heavens may look at you at dusk every few days: three waves of envoys, then the Heavenly General duels you alone (only your own blows count). Win for a quarter bar, Origin Stones and heaven seal shards; lose and you keep everything but carry Luka Langit for 10 minutes. It never comes while you are away, busy, on Peaceful or outside the Overworld and the Immortal Realm.
Slay a primordial beast in the Immortal Realm.
